caption: The video showcases a wide view of a mountain waterfall pouring over a horizontal rocky ledge into a turquoise plunge pool. Gray-brown cliffs covered with green moss, shrubs and conifers frame it along the top. The broad white cascade is already falling and keeps falling continuously. Its frothy sheet churns while the overall position and width stay constant. In the foreground a stream rushes over rounded brown and gray boulders, generating white rapids. The shape and brightness of these rapids swirl and shift. Subtle ripples move across the pool surface near the base of the falls. The underlying rocks, cliff walls, tree line and pool outline appear steady, while the moving water creates the visible change.
